scope: independently labeled projected-position correspondence accuracy; not camera quality or DNF

paired_video_uncertainty.interpretation: paired resampling of whole videos; equal weight per video with labeled examples; descriptive uncertainty, not independent-frame significance or proof of generalization

limitations: previously evaluated videos; dependent frames/tracks/methods grouped by video; accuracy excludes unavailable and borderline references, whose counts remain reported; absent reference classes make balanced accuracy unavailable; no camera-level DNF labels; NCC baseline added after first-video label inspection

exploratory_rgb_track_comparison.policy: existing RGB-only LK observation, FB <=1 pixel and source NCC >=0.8; distance to proposed pixel <=2 close, >=8 far, otherwise uncertain; missing/rejected observations abstain, never infer occlusion
exploratory_rgb_track_comparison.timing: added after reference counts and partial base-model responses were observed; not preregistered; no threshold sweep or model selection
exploratory_rgb_track_comparison.interpretation: descriptive same-example comparison stratified by the fixed RGB-track decision; no fitted fallback rule or camera-level DNF claim; strata analysis added before completed adapted-model responses
